notablePrerequisites:
Volrath does not have summoning sickness.
Morselhoarder has any counter on it.
Devoted Druid has at least one counter on it.
description:
Pay {1} to activate Volrath to make it a copy of Devoted Druid .
Tap and untap Volrath using Devoted Druid's ability four times, adding four {G} and four -1/-1 counters.
Pay {G} to activate Volrath ability targeting Morselhoarder.
Remove four -1/-1 counters from Volrath, adding four mana of any color.
Repeat.
